caption:
Score every resume branch against target postings using a curated taxonomy.

JobRez uses deterministic role matching through a curated technology taxonomy with aliases and whole-word matching. Required terms are weighted double and preferred terms once, with no cloud AI and no external verification.

One master resume serves as your baseline, where branches are copies tailored per role and each branch is scored against the posting in Job DNA.

Build your master resume and match roles at https://jobrez.com.
